en.description:
Enjoy a growing collection of fun and easy mini games designed for Apple Watch and iPhone.  
Turn your Apple Watch into a pocket-sized arcade.  

Challenge yourself, beat your high scores, and enjoy quick bursts of fun anytime, anywhere.

• Designed for Apple Watch, also available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac  
• 20+ mini games in one app, updated monthly  
• Weekly Free Games — a new game free every week  
• Fully offline — no Wi-Fi needed  
• No ads, no tracking, no interruptions  
• Compete on weekly and all-time leaderboards via Game Center, compete against players worldwide.
• Play multiplayer games with friends or challenge invincible AI  
• Smooth controls optimized for small screens, running at 60fps  
• Haptic feedback and sound effects for an immersive experience  
• Simple design — easy to play, hard to master  

Perfect for quick play during:  
Commuting · Waiting · Meetings · Breaks · Travel · Offline moments  

New games are updated monthly. 
Launched Games:  
Chinese Chess!
Delivery Run — Fast & Furious, Precision Dodge
Merge Everything — Combine items to create higher-level objects  
Gold Miner — Aim true hook big, uncover treasures
Tetris — Stack blocks and clear lines  
2048 — Slide tiles to reach 2048  
Breakout — Bounce hard, smash every brick
JumpJump — Tap to jump, rise higher and higher
Sokoban — Push boxes strategically to reach target spots  
Tic Tac Toe — Classic 3-in-a-row strategy game with infinite mode  
Gomoku — Get five in a row to win  
Spider Solitaire — Clear the table by arranging cards in sequence  
Emoji Skewers — Match and sort identical emojis  
Klotski — Slide blocks to free the main piece  
Tetris Fall — A faster-paced falling block challenge  
Snake — Grow longer while avoiding collisions  
Minesweeper — Use logic to find all mines  
Sudoku — Fill the grid without repeating numbers  
Math 24 — Use math operations to make 24  
Find the Plane Heads — Locate hidden targets on the grid  
Chinese Word Riddles — Guess the word from its punny hints.
...and more coming soon.

One-time purchase supported. Play across iPhone, Apple Watch, and Mac.

Download now and enjoy gaming on your wrist.

Thank you for your feedback — I’ve received and taken all of it into action. This update includes:
1. Added a solution feature to “Sokoban” on Apple Watch

Breakout on Apple Watch: added multiple control options — pick whichever feels best for you.
Breakout: fixed an issue where sound and haptics ignored your settings. (Sorry — it kind of gave away that you were slacking off)

Added a product release notes page.
Merge Game: Added sound effects and haptic feedback. Reaching the highest level now triggers an explosion effect.
Sudoku: Fixed an issue where all cells could be revealed directly.
Sokoban: Fixed Medium Difficulty Level 11.
Emoji Sort: Fixed an issue where tapping Refresh while moving items could immediately start the next round.

Breakout: fixed the ball getting stuck inside gray bricks, frame drops during TNT explosions, and the ball not dying after a board clear leaving the game unplayable after reviving.
Tetris: fixed a chance of the falling piece overlapping with the next spawned piece.
Emoji Skewers: fixed an issue caused by tapping undo while pieces were in flight.
Gomoku: increased the AI's thinking time.
Sokoban: reworked level 15.
Added an app recommendation: Miao Zhong — All-in-One Time Toolbox.

Relive the classic gameplay by hooking gold and diamonds.

Mine Sweeper: Added and opened a leaderboard — see how you really stack up!
Snake: Reworked the controls — from four directions to full 360° movement. Give it a try!
Improved game performance: Mine Sweeper, Jump Jump, and Spider Solitaire

Guess the word from its punny hints. Come challenge your wit!

Snake: added a joystick on Apple Watch for steering.
